text: I’ve had that happen on a few of mine. And nope it will expire when it normally expires. Doesn’t add time to it. I was told that it’s adjusting when it does that. Hum.

author: Douglas Canelon
text: The Libre 3+ sensor started giving good readings after the 10 hour readjustment period. I still wonder, why so long?.

author: Donna Wood-Dudley
text:
On older ones(2&3), I've had that happen occasionally ....it didn't . 
I've gone as long as waiting 24 hours from placement of it to start working. Usually, it just would begin to work & a few times> REPLACE THE SENSOR would occur 
I've not used the plus devices but aside from an extra day... I'm apt to say they're really no different in functions from prior fsl's or even dexcom and other makes
Pain  when it occurs but Abbott Lab did replace those that failed

author: Gene Holcombe
text:
No subtraction.  It works for the exact number of hours/days as programmed 
If you get that error it usually means the sensor was not fully applied or has become dislodged.   It will not report correct results now

author: Ray Listenbee
text: Yes. The “life” starts when activated and does not ever “pause”.
